scope: Public copies of completed 17a native evidence only. Original execution code and PNG bytes are unchanged. Only the exact known machine path/PATH literals identified by rule IDs are replaced in raw text copies. Original timestamps, source/head identities, observed states, counts and verdicts are retained.
exclusions: Compiled fixture.js and source maps are excluded; raw provenance retains their source/metafile input information.
No third-party dependency caches, node_modules trees or source worktrees are included.
Paths naming node_modules in metadata are provenance references, not included dependency files.
